$comment: Vocabulary expansions and normalisations applied by applyDictionary() in scripts/fix-markdown.mjs. Matching is word-boundary and case-preserving. Nothing is applied inside fenced code, inline code, URLs, file paths, link targets, or frontmatter.
$comment_enabled: Off by default, on the same terms as the DVW005/006/007 prose rules: pre-commit and the nightly cron both run --fix, so enabling this rewrites prose across the corpus unattended. Turn on, run `npm run lint:fix`, review the diff, commit the flag with it.
$comment_scope: Keep this list SMALL and unambiguous. Every entry rewrites prose across 620+ files on the next --fix, so a term that is sometimes meant literally (docs, config, dev, markdown) does not belong here. Add an entry only when the shorthand has exactly one expansion in every context.
$comment_expansions: Shorthand a writer types that should always be written out. Keys match whole words only, so 'maj' does not touch 'majority' or 'majeur'.
$comment_normalisations: Canonical spelling of product and technology names, applied in every locale. Only names with a single correct casing.
$comment_protected: Substrings that veto a rewrite anywhere they appear on the line. Case-sensitive.
